versions.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-docmind-parse: intelligent document parsing tool for Alibaba Cloud DocMind.

- Supports parsing PDF, Word, PPT, Excel, images and more; outputs Markdown/JSON/HTML.
- Provides two invocation modes: V2 API direct access and Alibaba Cloud POP, with automatic routing based on available credentials.
- Daily free quota for V2 API; 3,000 free pages/month for POP mode with pay-as-you-go after.
- Includes environment variable, error handling, and quota documentation.
- Command-line interface with various parameters for output format, enhancement mode, page range, and more.
- Includes usage examples and strict pre-validation rules for file existence and URL accessibility.
